# HTML Charts

> 94 free charts for dashboards. Each reads a grid on the same page and redraws it – no API, no install, and no data leaves the browser.

Built and maintained by Kai Jones, data analyst (CV: https://kaijxnes.com). Source: https://github.com/kaijxnes/HTML-Charts

How it works: add a grid with the chart's columns to the dashboard page, add an HTML container that runs JavaScript, paste the snippet. Charts look for generic headers (Month Key, Metric 1…, Dimension A…); map other names with data-columns='{"key":"Header"}' on the placeholder div. Dates are auto-detected (20261023, 23/10/2026, 2026 W44, 202610, October, 2026 …); data-date-format="DD/MM/YYYY" pins a format. All demo data on the site is random.

## Charts

- [Monthly Bars](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/monthly-bars): A $ metric by month as bars, with a toggle between three metrics, 6-month average cards and a second metric as a line. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/monthly-bars-1.4.3.js
- [Stacked Segments](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/stacked-segments): Metric × units by month, stacked by segment (any combination of three dimensions), with filters and a ranking. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/stacked-segments-1.5.2.js
- [Segment Breakdown](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/segment-breakdown): The stacked segment view for grids with the month first and two dimensions – starts on Dimension A, combine with Dimension C. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/segment-breakdown-1.5.2.js
- [Cost vs Return](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/cost-vs-return): Cost against return (units × value) by month: net return, ROI, cost per unit vs value per unit and a monthly table. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/cost-vs-return-1.5.2.js
- [Month Heatmap](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/month-heatmap): A heatmap of a $ metric by start month and month index – per month, cumulative or per unit – with every month's curve against the average. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/month-heatmap-1.5.2.js
- [KPI Scorecard](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/kpi-scorecard): Up to six metrics as cards with the latest value, change vs the previous month, a 3-month average or last year, and a sparkline; click one for its trend. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/kpi-scorecard-1.5.2.js
- [Time Series Trio](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/time-series-trio): Three metrics, each on its own row: a scorecard for the latest 7/28/90 days or months against the period before, next to a chart of all the data over time. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/time-series-trio-1.5.2.js
- [Funnel](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/funnel): Counts through ordered stages as a funnel, with step and overall conversion, the biggest drop-off and a conversion curve per segment. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/funnel-1.5.2.js
- [Change Bridge](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/change-bridge): A waterfall from one total to another, showing how much each item added or took away – e.g. last period to this period. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/change-bridge-1.5.2.js
- [Pareto](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/pareto): Items ranked largest first with a cumulative share line, showing how few items make up 80% of the total. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/pareto-1.5.2.js
- [Target Pacing](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/target-pacing): Month-to-date actual against target by day, with a month-end projection, % of target and the daily rate needed to hit it. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/target-pacing-1.5.2.js
- [Quadrant Scatter](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/quadrant-scatter): Each item plotted by two metrics, sized by a third, split into four quadrants at the averages – spot the high-value, low-cost winners. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/quadrant-scatter-1.5.2.js
- [Mix Shift](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/mix-shift): How the share of a total moves between segments month by month, as 100% stacked bars with gains and losses in points. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/mix-shift-1.5.2.js
- [Ribbon Chart](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/ribbon-chart): Stacked columns ranked each month, with ribbons showing how each segment's size and rank move. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/ribbon-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Calendar Heatmap](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/calendar-heatmap): A daily metric laid out as a calendar, one square per day, with averages by weekday and totals by month. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/calendar-heatmap-1.5.2.js
- [Year over Year](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/year-over-year): A metric by calendar month for this year against the two before, monthly or year to date, with the YTD change. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/year-over-year-1.5.2.js
- [Leaderboard](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/leaderboard): A ranked table for any month with change vs the month before, rank movement, share, a 12-month total and a trend sparkline. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/leaderboard-1.5.2.js
- [Distribution](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/distribution): A histogram of one value per row (e.g. per customer or order), with median, mean, P10–P90 and how much the top 10% hold – optionally split into groups. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/distribution-1.5.2.js
- [Target Attainment](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/target-attainment): Actual against target for every item as bullet bars, coloured by % of target, with the overall position and who's furthest ahead or behind. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/target-attainment-1.5.2.js
- [Anomaly Watch](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/anomaly-watch): A daily or monthly metric against its rolling average with a normal band, flagging the points that are unusually high or low. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/anomaly-watch-1.5.2.js
- [Treemap](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/treemap): Rectangles sized by value, grouped by one dimension and split by a second – click a group to zoom in. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/treemap-1.5.2.js
- [Small Multiples](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/small-multiples): A small chart per segment, side by side, with the latest value and change – on the same scale or each on its own. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/small-multiples-1.5.2.js
- [Variance Table](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/variance-table): A table of up to three metrics by segment for any month against the previous month or last year, with colour-coded changes and totals. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/variance-table-1.5.2.js
- [Gauges](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/gauges): Up to 12 KPIs as dials against their targets, with red/amber/green zones and a target marker. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/gauges-1.5.2.js
- [Combo Chart](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/combo-chart): Bars for one metric with one or two more as lines on a second axis, grouped by day, week, month, quarter or year. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/combo-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Flow (Sankey)](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/flow-sankey): How a total flows from one dimension to another – e.g. source to outcome – as bands sized by value. Click a node to highlight its flows. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/flow-sankey-1.5.2.js
- [Box Plot](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/box-plot): The spread of a value within each group – median, middle 50%, whiskers, mean and outliers – to compare groups fairly. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/box-plot-1.5.2.js
- [Radar Compare](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/radar-compare): Compare up to five segments across several metrics on one radar, each metric scored 0–100 against the best segment. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/radar-compare-1.5.2.js
- [Bump Chart](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/bump-chart): How each segment's rank changes month by month – who's rising, who's falling and how often the leader changes. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/bump-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Indexed Growth](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/indexed-growth): Every segment's trend indexed to 100 at a base month, so growth can be compared regardless of size. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/indexed-growth-1.5.2.js
- [Dumbbell](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/dumbbell): Before and after for every item as two joined dots, coloured by whether it got better or worse. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/dumbbell-1.5.2.js
- [Correlation Matrix](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/correlation-matrix): How strongly up to six metrics move together across rows, as a colour-coded matrix – click a cell to see the scatter. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/correlation-matrix-1.5.2.js
- [Time Series Stack](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/time-series-stack): Up to six metrics, each on its own row with a latest-range scorecard and a chart of all the data over time. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/time-series-stack-1.5.2.js
- [Time Series – 1 metric](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/time-series-single): One metric with a scorecard for the latest 7/28/90 days against the period before, next to its full history. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/time-series-trio-1.5.2.js
- [Time Series – 2 metrics](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/time-series-duo): Two metrics, each with a latest-range scorecard and a chart over time. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/time-series-trio-1.5.2.js
- [KPI Scorecard – 3 metrics](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/kpi-scorecard-trio): Three KPI cards with the latest value, change and sparkline, and a trend chart for the selected one. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/kpi-scorecard-1.5.2.js
- [Combo Chart – bar + line](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/combo-bar-line): One metric as bars and one as a line on a second axis – e.g. a total and a rate. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/combo-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Variance Table – 1 metric](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/variance-table-single): One metric by segment for any month against the previous month or last year. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/variance-table-1.5.2.js
- [Funnel – no segments](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/funnel-simple): A single funnel from stage counts, with step and overall conversion and the biggest drop-off. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/funnel-1.5.2.js
- [Treemap – one level](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/treemap-flat): One tile per item, sized by value. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/treemap-1.5.2.js
- [Value Matrix](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/value-matrix): A heatmap of value per unit across two dimensions, weighted by volume. No date needed. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/value-matrix-1.5.2.js
- [Month-to-Date Compare](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/mtd-compare): This month to date vs last month and last year at the same day. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/mtd-compare-1.5.2.js
- [Conversion Trend](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/conversion-trend): Funnel conversion rates over time, step by step. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/conversion-trend-1.5.2.js
- [Heat Table](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/heat-table): Pivot table with colour-scaled cells and totals. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/heat-table-1.5.2.js
- [Lollipop Chart](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/lollipop-chart): Ranked stems and dots, average line and last month's position. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/lollipop-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Cumulative Distribution](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/cumulative-distribution): Share of rows at or below each value, per group (ECDF). Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/cumulative-distribution-1.5.2.js
- [Ridgeline](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/ridgeline): Distribution shapes stacked by group or month, with medians. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/ridgeline-1.5.2.js
- [Spiral Plot](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/spiral-plot): Years wound into a spiral so the same month lines up each turn. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/spiral-plot-1.5.2.js
- [Cycle Plot](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/cycle-plot): Each calendar month across the years – season and trend side by side. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/cycle-plot-1.5.2.js
- [Price-Volume-Mix Bridge](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/pvm-bridge): Change in value split into volume, mix and rate effects. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/pvm-bridge-1.5.2.js
- [Burn-down](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/burn-down): Budget left by day against an even-spend line, with run-out date. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/burn-down-1.5.2.js
- [Growth Accounting](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/growth-accounting): New and returning up, lost down, net change and quick ratio per period. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/growth-accounting-1.5.2.js
- [Trend Scatter](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/trend-scatter): Scatter with best-fit line, r² and outliers flagged. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/trend-scatter-1.5.2.js
- [Radial Bars](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/radial-bars): A top 10 as rings – an eye-catching ranked bar chart. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/radial-bars-1.5.2.js
- [Word Cloud](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/word-cloud): Words sized by value – search terms, reasons, tags. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/word-cloud-1.5.2.js
- [Goal Rings](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/goal-rings): Progress to target as concentric rings, plus a full list. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/goal-rings-1.5.2.js
- [Interval Plot](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/interval-plot): Estimates with their ranges, flagged when clearly above or below average. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/interval-plot-1.5.2.js
- [Motion Scatter](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/motion-scatter): Animated bubbles moving period by period, with trails. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/motion-scatter-1.5.2.js
- [Bar Chart Race](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/bar-chart-race): Animated top 10 – bars overtake each other period by period. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/bar-chart-race-1.5.2.js
- [Cohort Curves](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/cohort-curves): One line per cohort as it ages, against the average. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/cohort-curves-1.5.2.js
- [Target Trend](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/target-trend): Actual vs target over time, shaded ahead/behind, with what's needed to catch up. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/target-trend-1.5.2.js
- [Likert Bars](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/likert-bars): Survey answers as diverging bars, with NPS for 0–10 scores. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/likert-bars-1.5.2.js
- [Grouped Bars](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/grouped-bars): Side-by-side bars per category, from a dimension or several metrics. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/grouped-bars-1.5.2.js
- [Dot Plot](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/dot-plot): A dot per series on each row – cleaner than grouped bars. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/dot-plot-1.5.2.js
- [Parallel Coordinates](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/parallel-coordinates): Items as lines across up to six metric axes – trade-offs and clusters. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/parallel-coordinates-1.5.2.js
- [Weekday Profile](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/weekday-profile): A typical day of the week from daily data, with this week on top. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/weekday-profile-1.5.2.js
- [Rolling 12 Months](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/rolling-12): Monthly bars with the moving annual total – trend without the season. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/rolling-12-1.5.2.js
- [Forecast](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/forecast-chart): Trend + seasonal projection with an 80% range. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/forecast-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Percentile Bands](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/percentile-bands): Median with 25–75 and 10–90 percentile bands over time. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/percentile-bands-1.5.2.js
- [UpSet Plot](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/upset-plot): Every combination as a bar, with a dot matrix – overlaps of 4+ groups. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/upset-plot-1.5.2.js
- [Venn Overlap](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/venn-overlap): 2–3 overlapping circles with the count in every overlap. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/venn-overlap-1.5.2.js
- [Concentration Curve](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/concentration-curve): How much of the total comes from the biggest items – with a Gini score. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/concentration-curve-1.5.2.js
- [Sparkline Table](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/sparkline-table): One row per item with a mini trend, latest value and changes. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/sparkline-table-1.5.2.js
- [Punch Card](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/punch-card): Weekday × hour dots – when in the week things actually happen. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/punch-card-1.5.2.js
- [Timeline](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/timeline-chart): Gantt-style bars from start to end date, coloured by group, with today marked. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/timeline-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Streamgraph](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/streamgraph): Flowing layers around a centre line – a total and its mix over time. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/streamgraph-1.5.2.js
- [YTD Race](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/ytd-race): This year's running total against last year's and target, with a full-year projection. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/ytd-race-1.5.2.js
- [Bubble Cloud](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/bubble-cloud): Packed bubbles sized by value and coloured by group – what's big, at a glance. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/bubble-cloud-1.5.2.js
- [Chord Diagram](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/chord-diagram): Flows between items around a circle – who sends what to whom. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/chord-diagram-1.5.2.js
- [Butterfly Chart](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/butterfly-chart): Two measures back to back per item, like a population pyramid. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/butterfly-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Beeswarm](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/beeswarm): Every item as a dot, one swarm per group, with the median – spread and outliers at a glance. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/beeswarm-1.5.2.js
- [Rose Chart](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/rose-chart): Months as petals around a clock face, with last year's outline – seasonality at a glance. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/rose-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Horizon Chart](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/horizon-chart): Dozens of trends in a small space – each band shaded by how far it is from its own average. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/horizon-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Diverging Bars](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/diverging-bars): Gains to the right, losses to the left: change or variance per item around zero. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/diverging-bars-1.5.2.js
- [Waffle Chart](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/waffle-chart): 100 squares, each 1% of the total – shares you can literally count. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/waffle-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Sunburst](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/sunburst): Two-level breakdown as rings – click a slice to zoom in. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/sunburst-1.5.2.js
- [Marimekko](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/marimekko): Column width = size, column split = mix: two dimensions' shares in one picture. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/marimekko-1.5.2.js
- [Cohort Triangle](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/cohort-triangle): The classic cohort retention triangle: start month × periods since start, as % retained, values or cumulative per unit. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/cohort-triangle-1.5.2.js
- [Slope Chart](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/slope-chart): Before and after for each item as up/down lines, with rank changes and % change. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/slope-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Bullet Chart](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/bullet-chart): Actual vs target per item as compact bars, with performance bands and a previous-period marker. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/bullet-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Donut Chart](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/donut-chart): Share of a total by segment, with the change in share against the previous period. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/donut-chart-1.5.2.js
- [Contribution Breakdown](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/contribution-breakdown): Bars by any dimension, split by up to two others, for total value, volume or value per unit. No date needed. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/contribution-breakdown-1.5.2.js
- [Quadrant Scatter – 2 metrics](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/quadrant-scatter-plain): Items plotted by two metrics, split into quadrants at the averages, without bubble sizing. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/quadrant-scatter-1.5.2.js
- [Radar Compare – 4 metrics](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/radar-compare-four): Segments compared across four metrics on a radar. Script: https://viz.kaijxnes.com/charts/radar-compare-1.5.2.js

## Full reference

- [llms-full.txt](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/llms-full.txt): every chart's columns, options and use cases in one file
- [About](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/about): why it was built and how it works
- [Privacy](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/privacy): Google Analytics only with consent; the chart scripts collect nothing

## Setup

- [How to set up](https://viz.kaijxnes.com/platforms): MicroStrategy, plain web pages, Tableau, Looker, Power BI and Qlik
